title: FragmentSender attempts documentation excludes ACK-REQ attempts
description: Final ACK correctness review: python/src/lichen/schc/fragment.py:744-748 describes attempts as the number of All-1 transmissions, but the state machine also increments it for ACK REQ emissions in timeout and missing-regular-fragment paths. Update the public contract to describe total All-1/ACK-REQ request attempts and distinguish generated output from confirmed radio transmission. Add assertions covering both increment paths so documentation and semantics cannot drift.
